name: Linda Nosková
intro: Linda Nosková is a tall, hard-hitting player from Czechia. She just won Wimbledon this summer! That is a Grand Slam, one of the four biggest tournaments.
story: Linda grew up in a tiny village surrounded by forest. Her mom and dad played tennis just for fun. Her dad put a racket in her hands at about age six. This July she won her first Grand Slam at Wimbledon. On Friday she won a tough three-set match, so she plays again Sunday.

funFacts.text: As a kid she tried gymnastics, horse riding, and running before picking tennis.
She has loved pro wrestling since age 14. WWE star Charlotte Flair cheered for her this week!
Her favorite player growing up was Serena Williams.
She spent a week helping at a school in Zanzibar, an island in Africa.
She wears a small nose ring. She says it brings good luck.
At Wimbledon she was the youngest champion in 15 years.
She beat world No. 1 Iga Swiatek when she was only 19.

watchFor: Count how many winners she cracks past her opponent with that booming forehand.
